meta.title: Lesson 22: Write a Better Prompt
meta.title_zh: 第 22 课：写出更好的提示词

study_card.main_practice: 跟读 + 精读 + 中文讲解对照
study_card.suggested_pace: 先猜大意 · 再听读 · 最后完成英文输出

segments.en: I ask an AI tool to explain a Python error. My first prompt is too short: fix this. The answer is vague. I add the goal, the error message, and the code around the error. The second answer is more useful.
segments.tts: I ask an AI tool to explain a Python error. My first prompt is too short: fix this. The answer is vague. I add the goal, the error message, and the code around the error. The second answer is more useful.
segments.zh: 我让 AI 工具解释一个 Python 错误。我的第一个提示词太短：修复这个。答案很模糊。我补充目标、错误信息和错误附近的代码，第二个答案更有用。讲解：vague=模糊的，around=附近，useful=有用的。

segments.en: A good prompt gives the model a role and a format. I say: act as a patient teacher. Explain the error in three short steps. Use simple English and Chinese notes. The format makes the answer easier to read.
segments.tts: A good prompt gives the model a role and a format. I say: act as a patient teacher. Explain the error in three short steps. Use simple English and Chinese notes. The format makes the answer easier to read.
segments.zh: 好的提示词会给模型一个角色和格式。我说：请像耐心的老师一样，用三个短步骤解释错误，使用简单英语和中文笔记。格式会让答案更容易阅读。讲解：role=角色，format=格式，patient=耐心的，step=步骤。

segments.en: I do not ask the model to guess missing facts. I tell it to say when it is unsure. A clear limit protects the answer. Prompts are instructions, not magic words.
segments.tts: I do not ask the model to guess missing facts. I tell it to say when it is unsure. A clear limit protects the answer. Prompts are instructions, not magic words.
segments.zh: 我不要求模型猜测缺失事实，而是告诉它不确定时要说出来。清楚的限制可以保护答案。提示词是指令，不是魔法词。讲解：guess=猜测，unsure=不确定的，limit=限制，magic=魔法的。

chunks.eg: The first prompt is too short.
Explain it in three short steps.

patterns.cn: 我的第一个提示词是 X。
用 Y 个步骤解释 X。

transfer_tasks.task: Write a prompt for an English tutor. Use act as a teacher, in three short steps, and say when you are unsure.
